bundle.shortDescription: A premium, Rust-powered file explorer for Windows
bundle.longDescription: Nexus Explorer is a fast, reliable and elegant file manager built on a Rust engine and a modern desktop UI. It brings tabs, instant search, resumable transfers, previews, checksums and a command palette into one focused workspace.
